title: GTA 6 Sahara Arena: where it is and the real Miami arena behind it

title_rule: Map Shorts lead with the search phrase ('gta 6 sahara arena', 'gta 6 kaseya center')
short_description:
GTA 6 Sahara Arena location: it's labelled on Rockstar's official map in Downtown Vice City, on the bay east of Crosstown, the same spot Miami's Kaseya Center (home of the Miami Heat) holds in real life. Fan guides and GTA Wiki call it GTA 6's Kaseya Center; the name comes from Sahara, GTA's Amazon parody. In real life, on November 18, 2026, the Heat hosted "A Night in Vice City" at Kaseya Center: Vice City jerseys (Nike, Cactus Jack, Rockstar) and a Vice City court. No story spoilers.

Sources: Rockstar Games (official map), NBA.com (Miami Heat), ABC7/AP, GTABoom, GTA Wiki, Yardbarker, GTA6 Intel.

short_es.title: GTA 6: el KASEYA Center de Vice City 🏀 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description:
El Sahara Arena de GTA 6 está en el mapa oficial de Rockstar: Downtown Vice City, junto a la bahía, al este de Crosstown, justo donde está el Kaseya Center de los Miami Heat en la vida real. Las guías de fans y la GTA Wiki lo llaman el Kaseya Center de GTA 6; el nombre viene de Sahara, la parodia de Amazon en GTA. Y en la vida real, el 18 de noviembre de 2026, los Heat jugaron "A Night in Vice City" en el Kaseya Center con camisetas y cancha de Vice City (Nike, Cactus Jack y Rockstar). Sin spoilers.

Fuentes: Rockstar Games (mapa oficial), NBA.com (Miami Heat), ABC7/AP, GTABoom, GTA Wiki, Yardbarker.
